name: Protopasta Metal Composite PETG @base
filament_notes:
Copper, Steel (400-series stainless) and Iron composite PETG, each 60% metal by weight. Proto-Pasta: density about 2x PETG, so a spool gives about half the length. This profile uses 2.4 g/cm3 for all three - an estimate.
Prints like PETG (Proto-Pasta used Generic PETG temperatures); a slightly lower nozzle temperature reduces stringing, so this profile defaults to 245C. Avoid very low volume rates (below 2 mm3/s), and lower the temperature if you must print slowly. Use glue stick. A hardened nozzle is a good idea for metal-filled filament.
